title: Playboy Magazine Lot 4 August 1976 April 1977 Lingerie + 1 Random Magazine
descriptionText:
Description

Lot of 4 vintage Playboy magazines and special editions.

Includes:

Playboy — August 1976
Illustrated butterfly cover. Features Playboy’s Pro Football Preview and Robert Altman interview.

Playboy — April 1977
“Girls of the New South” cover. Features the Secret Files of Howard Hughes and Gary Gilmore interview.

Playboy’s Book of Lingerie — September/October 1991
“Falling in Love With Intimate Apparel.”

Playboy’s Bathing Beauties
“Sexiest Girls on the Beach” special edition.

All four magazines shown are included.

These are vintage, pre-owned magazines and show age-related handling/storage wear. There may be edge wear, corner wear, surface marks, creases or other imperfections. Please review the photos carefully for the exact condition of each magazine.

Sold together as one lot of 4 + 1
